node: Data-center electrical equipment: switchgear, transformers, busway, backup power, and power distribution
summary: Layer 1B expansion finds a narrow but investable US-listed universe around AI/data-center electrical equipment. The strongest underfollowed direct signal is Powell Industries, where record backlog, high book-to-bill, and a disclosed data-center mega-order tie the AI buildout to medium-voltage switchgear and engineered electrical systems. nVent is a broader but still relatively less-obvious electrical connection/protection and busway/switchgear exposure, strengthened by its Avail Electrical Products acquisition and record 2026 backlog. Vertiv remains the high-attention reference leader for critical power/cooling infrastructure. AZZ is a second-order materials/services candidate: less direct, but potentially exposed through galvanized/coated steel used in power transmission, generation, and data-center infrastructure. No buy/sell view is implied; all candidates require later-layer evidence checks on revenue mix, margins, backlog conversion, and customer/project specificity.
